record.read: The free entry point is no longer a visible price card, which pushes larger Basic usage into a sales conversation. The Pro card now leads with container monitoring and OpenTelemetry, which Basic hosts do not get.

record.caveat: The removed digital signage bullet may be a copy change rather than a withdrawn feature.

record.caveat: Essential has flipped between $19 and $29 several times in recent weeks, so this may be a promotion test rather than a settled price.
